newsitem.title: USA: Third mail bomb defused in San Diego.
newsitem.headline: Third mail bomb defused in San Diego.

text.p: A bomb squad from the San Diego County Sheriff's Department defused the third mail bomb found in the area in as many days on Saturday night, police said.
According to Chula Vista police, the bomb was mailed to the home of a federal employee who grew suspicious and called police on Saturday evening.

Police evacuated residents from 12 homes in this quiet residential area south of San Diego before the bomb was removed and defused outside. Residents began moving back into their homes later on Saturday night.
The bomb was the third found in the area recently.

On Friday, the sheriff's bomb squad detonated a package that had been sent to Laidlaw Waste Systems, a waste disposal firm, in Chula Vista, after an employee became suspicious and reported it to police.
A package containing a pipe bomb was also mailed to FBI headquarters in San Diego on Thursday and detonated outside the building that night.
FBI officials would not say whether the third package was similar to the other two and would not release any further information about the incident.
